title: Move Amplify CI/CD to GitHub artifact deployment
description: Replace the Git-connected Amplify build with GitHub Actions CI and deploy only the tested static artifact to a manual-deployment Amplify app. Preserve the old app as rollback until the new app and domain are verified; eliminate Amplify build-minute usage.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Decision: Apricity uses Amplify Gen 2 for its backend, so the existing Git-connected app will remain solely as the backend target for GitHub's pipeline deployment. A new manual Amplify hosting app will receive the tested static frontend artifact. This removes frontend CI from Amplify while preserving the existing backend and its rollback path.
